svg.title: Case E: Human material is replenished
svg.desc: Calculated illustrative model v0.2. Four input-rate trajectories from model time zero to one hundred: human intellectual material, AI investigation, human observations and machine observations. Both axes use normalised model units. Assumed parameters are not empirical estimates. All six exhibits use the same scales.
